justification: Both surfaces include human-like figures and repeated linear marks, but A shows highly schematic stick-figures, ships with rows of crew strokes and small animals scattered over an open field, while B shows a single large, anatomically modelled bearded figure cloaked in a scaled fish-skin, holding a bucket, framed in a rectangular panel. There is no shared motif, relationship or compositional scheme: outline stick-figure rock art versus modelled naturalistic relief of a composite being.
